CI-Bot: e2e/perf-suite (master) — FAILED: latency gate violated. p95=120ms p99=242ms (threshold p99<=200ms). Job: https://ci.redwood/jenkins/job/e2e-perf/1234 :rotating_light:

Maria: saw this in the dashboard too. p99 looks consistently higher after last deploy.

Raj: Can someone bisect between d1a2f3 -> 7b8c9d? I suspect the batching change from Jen's PR.

Jen: I'm looking. My PR only touched batching reconciliation for dynamic batching windows; shouldn't affect p99 but could change batching behavior.

Sam: Quick check — can we rerun just the perf job (no infra change)? I'll kick a rerun now.

CI-Bot: Rerun queued by Sam — e2e/perf-suite #1235

Maria: Also can we capture perf traces and the runtime kernel selection logs? Add env VAR PERF_TRACE=1

Raj: If rerun still shows spike, request bisect from infra to runtime. @ops oncall any infra deployments around that time?

OpsBot: No infra deployments in the 2hrs before the failing run. Network flaps noted earlier in region-us-west-2 at 02:10 UTC.

Jen: I pushed a tiny debug build with KV_CACHE=0 on a branch, can we try that as an additional job? Might rule out kv-cache optimization.

Sam: I'll queue a job with those envs and attach links when done.

Maria: Thanks — if rerun passes, we'll mark flaky and close. If it fails, tag @perf-team for bisect.

Raj: tagging perf-team: @Jen @Maria @Sam :eyes:

CI-Bot: e2e/perf-suite #1235 COMPLETED — FAILED (p99=238ms). Logs: https://ci.redwood/..../1235/log

Sam: logs show increased tokenization time in step 'encode'. Attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-17T02:15:30Z runtime: tokenization 48ms -> 120ms
```

Jen: Hmm tokenization shouldn't vary much. Could be test harness changed input length distribution.

Maria: Good catch. I ran a quick local sample — one of the synthetic prompt generators had a seed change in the fixture. Reverting should be quick. I'll open PR.

Raj: Nice. If Maria's PR reverts fixture, let's schedule a rerun and re-evaluate. Thanks all.

Maria: opened PR #4567 — revert synthetic-seed. Kicking rerun after merge.

CI-Bot: Merge detected, new run e2e/perf-suite #1236 queued.

CI-Bot: Run #1236 COMPLETED — PASSED (p99=182ms) :tada:

Sam: closing then. Follow-up: add a small check in the harness to freeze prompt seeds.

Maria: filed issue #789 for seed-lock in harness.

Raj: great teamwork.
